inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: This standard was evaluated regarding an investigation, and a violation was found. It was determined that the caregiver interacted with the victim inappropriately by taking the equipment and not addressing the concern immediately with the parent and the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of ten student files were missing updated immunization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three of the 10 children's records reviewed have incomplete emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Four of the 10 children's records reviewed have incomplete physician or emergency care facility information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Operating Times: The operational policies are missing the following sections.    746.501 (18)(B),(C),(D),(E),(F),(G), (19),(22),(23),(26)(B),(C),(D),(E), (28) and (30).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Operating Times (26 TAC §746.501(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: Parents of infants in the 12-17 month classroom do not regularly receive daily reports. Daily reports do not include infant activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three infants that are not on table food do not have current feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit: One of the five personnel records reviewed does not have a notarized affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One of the five caregiver records reviewed do not have first aid training. Two of the five caregiver records reviewed are not current in pediatric first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Caregivers are unable to properly supervise during times in which administrative duties were completed. This included preparing food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System: Children's attendance records are not properly maintained. Not all children are signed in and out daily.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System (26 TAC §746.801(19))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Classrooms do not have the list of ages for children. Caregivers are not aware of children's ages.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: A class was not served water with snack. This was corrected at inspection when water was served.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: A classroom was observed watching a movie during naptime. This was corrected at inspection when the movie was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A tall bookshelf was not anchored to the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. Caregivers were observed on their phones while supervising a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. Napping children were not properly supervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: 6 out of 10 student files did not include a date of admission to the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection on file..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Vehicles used to transport children in care did not have fire extinguishers available when transporting children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 2 out of 10 student files reviewed did not include all required information for emergency contcat persons.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Staff did not have emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation did not have a current gas inspection on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 1 out of 10 student files reviewed did not include a signature to confirm that staff mayy provide any necessary emergency medical attention required for the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current health inspection on file at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: Operational policies did not include policies on the following:    1. Infant safe-sleep  2. Hearing and vision requirements  3. Water play  4. Indoor and outdoor activity physical activity promotion  5. Sunscreen/insect repellent  6. Procedures for parents to view the most recent Licensing inspection report and how the parent may access the minimum standards online  7. Instructions on how a parent may contact the local Licensing office, access the Texas  Abuse and Neglect Hotline, and access the HHSC website  8. Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employees  9. Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.  10. Any area within 1,000 feet of a child -care center is a gang-free zone
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Hazards on the playgrounds at the operation included several protruding nails, loose seat fixtures, and a large inoperable table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: 5 out of 10 student files reviewed did not include a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: There were no individual storage spaces designated for toddler and pre-k aged children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 1 out of 10 student files reviewed did not include current immunication records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
